properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-512 in two roles: HMAC-SHA512 as the BIP32 derivation MAC (hasher.rs:38,60 — meets CNSA 2.0 digest size) and as the PBKDF2 PRF in message.rs:52/83 and seed.rs:163/197. Quantum-irrelevant (Grover-only), but it wraps the weak 100-iteration PBKDF2 in seed.rs.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD sealing/opening grinbox messages (message.rs:54,93-97) and the encrypted wallet.seed file (seed.rs:166-169,199-202). Quantum-safe AEAD; the post-quantum weakness is the secp256k1 ECDH and 100-iteration PBKDF2 feeding the key, not the cipher. Random 12-byte nonces from rand::thread_rng.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.3 capability via rustls in the dependency tree; the live session (client.rs:185) uses library defaults. TLS 1.3 itself does not make the session post-quantum — its ECDHE groups are Shor-vulnerable; hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 would be required.
